summary: F1: Phishing-suspect mail from edevlet-burs-basvuru.com (subject: KYK burs ödemeniz beklemede) was delivered to g.sen@aegean.edu. F2: The user clicked the link to edevlet-burs-basvuru.com. No downstream abuse was confirmed; Risk Gate escalates at confidence 0.75 based on partial access signals.

actions.action: Reset g.sen@aegean.edu password and force MFA re-enrollment; review sign-in logs for anomalous access.
Block edevlet-burs-basvuru.com at email gateway and web proxy; hunt for and quarantine similar messages.
Run EDR scan on the user endpoint for post-click payloads or persistence.
Deliver targeted phishing awareness to the user regarding KYK scholarship lures.

limitations: Only delivery and click signals confirmed; no credential abuse or malware execution verified.
Escalation reason: signals of compromise without a confirmed abuse chain
not_checked: Endpoint telemetry and mailbox audit logs for g.sen@aegean.edu; broader campaign scope across Aegean University accounts.

contrastive.explanation: Rejecting F1, F2 would leave no surviving signal and the policy would land on benign — the opposite of the human-review path we chose.

risk.rationale: Verified evidence relevant to g.sen@aegean.edu is limited to F1 (confirmed phishing mail delivered from edevlet-burs-basvuru.com, T1566.002) and F2 (confirmed user clicked the link, T1204.001). These establish exposure/initial engagement but not a completed account takeover: there is no confirmed credential submission, no MFA bypass, and no unauthorized sign-in for this account. The VPN appliance KEV claim is explicitly rejected as irrelevant (vpn-edge-01 carried no sign-in for g.sen@aegean.edu), so it cannot support contain. The signals are confirmed rather than weak and cannot be explained away, ruling out monitor and benign; evidence is insufficient to confirm a takeover chain for contain. Human review is needed to determine whether credentials were entered on the phishing site and what containment (password reset/session revocation) is warranted.
escalate_reasons: signals of compromise without a confirmed abuse chain
